👤 Account

Signing in syncs your progress across devices. Playing as a guest works exactly the same — it just stays on this browser.

Sign in or create an account

Your password is handled by Supabase Auth and never stored in this app or in its source. Progress is saved to a row only your account can read.

☁ Cloud sync is not configured

This build has no Supabase project attached, so accounts are switched off and everything stays on this device. To turn it on: create a free project, run supabase_setup.sql in its SQL editor, then put the project URL and anon key into the SUPA block at the top of the page source.

🎓 Learn a Subject

One subject, taught in parts. Read a part → answer a few questions on that part → only move on once you have it. At the end: the full summary, then a ten-question exam on exactly what you just learned.
